DESKHAVEN WORKSPACES PRIVATE LIMITED
MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT - DEDICATED DESK

Membership Reference: DH-HSR-2026-0412
Centre: Deskhaven HSR, 3rd Floor, No. 27, 19th Main Road, Sector 4, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102 (the "Centre")

This Membership Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into at Bengaluru on 22nd September, 2026 between:

Deskhaven Workspaces Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at No. 118, 2nd Cross, Domlur Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560071 (the "Operator"); and

Mr. Aniruddha Sen, the sole proprietor of "Frame Forty Studio", a video editing and post-production business, residing at Flat G-2, Lakeview Enclave, 5th Main, BTM Layout 2nd Stage, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076 (the "Member").

The Operator and the Member are each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

BACKGROUND

The Operator operates shared, serviced workspaces in Bengaluru. The Member wishes to use a dedicated desk at the Centre, together with the shared facilities and services described below, and the Operator has agreed to provide them on the terms of this Agreement, the membership order form signed by the Member, and the House Rules.

1. MEMBERSHIP PLAN
1.1 The Operator grants the Member a membership for one (1) Dedicated Desk, Desk No. D-14, in the open-plan area of the Centre, with access 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for the use of the Member and not more than one (1) nominated associate of the Member.
1.2 The membership includes the use of shared meeting rooms for up to eight (8) hours per month, high-speed internet, printing of up to two hundred (200) pages per month, tea and coffee, a lockable pedestal drawer, and access to the common areas of the Centre.
1.3 The membership is a personal, non-exclusive permission to use the facilities of the Centre. It does not give the Member exclusive possession of any part of the Centre, and it does not create any tenancy or any other right or interest in any property.
1.4 The Member shall not use the address of the Centre as its registered office, as its principal place of business for GST registration, or for any other statutory registration, unless the Member separately subscribes to the Operator's Business Address plan.

2. TERM AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
2.1 The initial term of the membership is three (3) months, from 1st October, 2026 to 31st December, 2026 (the "Initial Term").
2.2 At the end of the Initial Term and of every renewal term, the membership shall automatically renew for a further period of three (3) months on the then-prevailing terms, unless the Member gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.
2.3 Notices of non-renewal or termination shall be valid only if sent by email to membership@deskhaven.example from the Member's registered email address. Notices given orally, through the Deskhaven app, by WhatsApp or to the staff at the Centre shall not be valid.
2.4 The Operator may terminate the membership at any time by giving the Member fifteen (15) days' written notice.

3. MEMBERSHIP FEE AND PAYMENT
3.1 The Member shall pay a monthly Membership Fee of Rs. 11,500/- (Rupees Eleven Thousand Five Hundred only), plus GST at the applicable rate, which is currently eighteen percent (18%).
3.2 The Membership Fee shall be paid in advance on or before the 1st day of each month through the payment link issued by the Operator. The Operator shall issue a tax invoice for every payment received.
3.3 The Operator may revise the Membership Fee at any time by giving the Member seven (7) days' notice by email, and the revised Membership Fee shall apply from the next billing cycle.
3.4 If any amount is not paid within five (5) days of its due date, the Member shall pay a late fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) for each day of delay, and the Operator may deactivate the Member's access card until all dues are paid.
3.5 Charges for additional services, such as meeting room hours beyond the included quota, printing beyond the included quota, parking and event space, shall be billed monthly at the Operator's standard rates as published from time to time.
3.6 All amounts payable by the Member are exclusive of GST and other applicable taxes, which shall be payable by the Member in addition. If the Member deducts tax at source from any payment, it shall provide the Operator with the corresponding certificate within the time prescribed by law.

4. REFUNDABLE DEPOSIT
4.1 The Member shall pay a refundable deposit equal to two (2) months' Membership Fee, namely Rs. 23,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Three Thousand only) (the "Refundable Deposit"), before the start of the Initial Term.
4.2 The Refundable Deposit shall be refunded without interest within forty-five (45) days after the end of the membership, after deducting any unpaid dues and the cost of repairing any damage caused by the Member, its associate or its guests.
4.3 If the Member terminates the membership before the end of the then-current term, the Refundable Deposit shall be forfeited in full, and the Member shall also pay the Membership Fee for the remainder of that term.

5. USE OF THE CENTRE AND HOUSE RULES
5.1 The Member shall comply with the House Rules of the Centre, which may be amended by the Operator from time to time at its sole discretion and which shall be binding on the Member from the date of their display at the Centre or on the Deskhaven app.
5.2 The Member shall use the Centre only for lawful office use and shall not carry on any activity that is illegal, hazardous, offensive or a nuisance to other members.
5.3 The Member may bring guests to the Centre only during business hours, after registering them at the reception. The Member shall be responsible for the conduct of its guests and for any damage caused by them.
5.4 The Member shall not install any equipment, make any alteration to the desk or the Centre, or connect any device to the Operator's network other than laptops and mobile phones, without the prior written consent of the Operator.
5.5 The Centre is monitored by CCTV cameras in its common areas, and the names and phone numbers of all visitors are recorded at the reception.
5.6 The Operator may, at its discretion, relocate the Member to any other desk in the Centre or to any other Deskhaven centre in Bengaluru by giving the Member forty-eight (48) hours' notice.
5.7 Meeting rooms must be booked through the Deskhaven app. Unused booked hours lapse at the end of each month and cannot be carried forward or exchanged for any refund.

6. SERVICES AND LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
6.1 The Operator shall use reasonable efforts to keep the Centre open, clean, secure, and supplied with electricity, internet and the other included services.
6.2 The Operator shall not be liable for any loss or damage, including loss of data, business, income or profits, arising from any interruption, failure or unavailability of internet, electricity or any other service, howsoever caused, including by the negligence of the Operator or its staff.
6.3 The Operator shall not be responsible for the loss of, or damage to, any belongings, equipment or data of the Member, its associate or its guests at the Centre, whether left at the desk, in the pedestal drawer or elsewhere.
6.4 The Member shall indemnify the Operator against all claims, losses and costs arising from any act or omission of the Member, its associate or its guests at the Centre.
6.5 The Member is advised to maintain its own insurance for its equipment and business, and the Operator shall have no obligation to insure the property of the Member.

7. NON-SOLICITATION OF STAFF
7.1 During the membership and for twelve (12) months after it ends, the Member shall not employ or engage any person who is or was employed by the Operator at the Centre during the membership. If the Member does so, the Member shall pay the Operator a placement fee of Rs. 2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh only) for each such person.

8. END OF MEMBERSHIP
8.1 On the last day of the membership, the Member shall vacate the desk, return all access cards and keys, and remove all of its belongings from the Centre by 6:00 p.m.
8.2 Any belongings left at the Centre after that time may be removed, stored or disposed of by the Operator without any liability, and the Member shall pay a storage and handling charge of Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only) per day until they are collected.
8.3 A charge of Rs. 750/- (Rupees Seven Hundred and Fifty only) shall be payable for every access card that is lost or not returned.

9. SUSPENSION AND TERMINATION BY THE OPERATOR
9.1 The Operator may suspend the Member's access to the Centre immediately and without notice if the Member breaches the House Rules or fails to pay any amount when due.
9.2 The Operator may terminate the membership immediately by written notice if the Member commits a material breach of this Agreement, and in such case the Refundable Deposit shall be forfeited.

10. GENERAL
10.1 This Agreement, together with the membership order form and the House Rules, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the membership.
10.2 The Member may not transfer or assign the membership without the prior written consent of the Operator.
10.3 Neither Party shall be liable for any failure to perform its obligations due to events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, epidemics, orders of any government authority and civil disturbances, except that the obligation of the Member to pay the Membership Fee shall continue.
10.4 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any matter arising from it.
10.5 This Agreement may be accepted electronically through the Deskhaven app, and such acceptance shall be as binding as a signature on paper.
